items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: I passed there and talked to him... A place named Grisby and Grisby, pressing shop... He's wonderful, him.

ctx.x: I passed there and talked to him. Rampart about a block left off Canal Street on the Riverside. On the Riverside? A place named Grisby and Grisby, pressing shop.
Yeah. He's got some girls in there playing. He's wonderful, him.
